title: Email markup primitives + brand tokens now duplicated in two modules (email_client privates copied into messages.gleam)
evidence: messages.gleam:444 `const brand_font = "'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif"` duplicates email_client.gleam:1245 `const brand_font = "'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif"`; messages.gleam:456/486/499/503 (`fn email_wrapper`, `fn cta_button`, `fn email_divider`, `fn fallback_link`) mirror the private fns at email_client.gleam:1283/1342/1355/1359, including brand colors #1B2A4A/#D4942A.
detail: Deliberate per spec decision 7 (extraction deferred until a third email family), so not a defect, but brand font/colors and wrapper markup are now two-source: a rebrand or wrapper change must edit both modules or the emails drift visually.
recommended_fix: No change now; when the next email family or any rebrand lands, extract a shared email_markup module (brand consts + wrapper/CTA/divider) per the spec's own trigger and migrate both callers.
